F1: The optimized paginator applies numeric rounding to datetime values, so nonempty audit-log results fail while building cursors.
F2: The endpoint dereferences the optional member before checking whether optimized pagination was requested, so memberless requests can fail.
F3: Advanced pagination passes negative offsets to Django queryset slicing, which raises an uncaught `ValueError`.
F4: The new sorted-set operations reuse keys that may still contain legacy Redis sets, causing `WRONGTYPE` errors.
